## 🇩🇪 German — Daily Phrases (3)
1. **Ich bin ganz in meinem Element.** — [ish bin gants in MY-nem eh-leh-MENT] — *I'm completely in my element.*
2. **Das lässt mich nicht los.** — [das lesst mish nisht LOHS] — *That won't let go of me. / I can't stop thinking about it.*
3. **Es schneit wie verrückt!** — [es SHNYTE vee fair-ROOKT] — *It's snowing like crazy!*
